best_idea: A per-player, per-command timer on the server that refuses while it runs, never restarts on a refusal, and decays by real elapsed time, so input spam is cut without any client-side trust.
decision_why: Keep the shape (keyed by command, refusal does not extend, host exempt, real-time decay); the wait values belong in the catalogue per command, and the duel's attack speed stays the source of truth for fight timing.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a second attack from one client 10 ms after the first is refused and does not extend the timer; an attack 1000 ms after the first is accepted; the host's inputs are never refused; under a slow server tick the same 1000 ms of real time passes before the next accept.
